newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean civic groups urge govt to revive Kia.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean civic groups urge govt to revive Kia.

text.p: South Korea's civic groups on Monday demanded the government take aggressive measures to revive the struggling Kia Group.
"It's impossible for Kia to survive on its own rescue plans without the government's financial help," a joint statement from 60 civic groups including women's and labour organisations said.
The statement also opposed a third-party takeover of Kia because it could result in a stronger concentration of economic powers in the society.
The government has so far said it has no plans to directly intervene to support the group.
Kia Group was put under the protection of its creditor banks on July 15 after they determined the company would default on debt payments.
